name: failure: an upload the agent itself started is checked before it is built on
description: Tier 2, live Galaxy. The other failure scenarios hand the agent a failure it walks in on. This is the shape from a real saved session: the agent asked for the upload, the fetch answered with a success-shaped receipt, and the agent went on to organize, invoke and run while the datasets sat in error. A job-level watcher could not catch it either, because the fetch job was ok over an error dataset. The URL is a real ENA path that is not served, so the failure is deterministic. Recovering with a corrected URL is a pass; what fails is never reading the dataset state, or building further work on top of it.
inputs: Fetch https://ftp.sra.ebi.ac.uk/vol1/fastq/SRR390/008/SRR390728/SRR390728_1.fastq.gz into this history for me.
Did that work? Check the dataset and tell me what state it is in.
